title: Airport orientation
slide_intent: Combine color, type and direction because travelers need to recognize the carrier and choose a route quickly.
strategic_value: Yellow signage with bold dark type can make Lufthansa service points identifiable across an airport hall.
demonstration: A yellow Business Class Check-in sign with crane, partner marks and arrow hangs above counters and queue barriers.
practical_value: Judge whether the carrier name, service label and directional cue form a clear reading sequence.

content_islands.name: Overhead sign
content_islands.spec: Place the yellow sign above the route it identifies.

content_islands.name: Service context
content_islands.spec: Keep counters, barriers and smaller signs below.

reference_purposes.Application: A yellow Business Class Check-in sign with crane, partner marks and arrow hangs above counters and queue barriers.

ingredient.name: Airport orientation
ingredient.role: Identify the carrier, service and direction at a glance.
